Saika Fuuma is a recurring characters character in the Online Universes.

She is a Taimanin Cyborg and was the secretary of the Fuuma clan. In RPGX and Action Taimanin, she passed her role on to Fuuma Tokiko but remained with Gosha Village, while in TABA, she joined Danjo's side in the revolt and left the village instead.



Personality
Saika is a really polite and soft spoken woman, specially towards those she serves. For most people she is an unapproachable ice queen, while beneath it has the heart of a maiden and is known for her strong sense of devotion, which would even allow herself to become a demon for her master. Saika is willing to go pretty far, for the once she fully supports, which makes her in sometimes morally grey.

If she fights Saika is a veteran, that also can act rather underhanded and her loyalty will drive her to super human levels of mental resistance. Saika will address people formerly with title like "master" and acts rather motherly, to younger people. She can also be very assertive with her desires and wishes.

Even within the timelines, in which Saika did not fully supported Fuuma Danjo, she still takes care of his scrolls and books as a sign of long running respect. Her loyality still runs deep, with her being undecided after Danjo's death what her place should be, even if she did not join any of the left over danjo loyalist Rogue Taimanin in RPGX or Action. In TABA, as Danjo was still alive and killed by Kotaro, she decided on revenge until she was defeated and reached a stage of acceptance. Her care for both Danjo and Kotaro can result in issues if both are on opposing sides.

She, Fuuma Tokiko and Fuuma Amane are more or less rivals but always understand each other more than many others. She also seems to respect one of her former rivals Mizuki Shiranui.


Appearance
Saika is a tall woman with very long brown hair and red eyes, she has lost her legs and is wearing either civilian or combat oriented prosthetics.

She wears a purple and white battle suit.

History
Background
Fuuma Saika 3
A Taimanin veteran of the Fuuma clan.

She is a member of a family of official secretaries who have served Fuuma clan for generations, and she herself has Fuuma's blood in her veins. Saika was the steward of the Fuuma clan and with that the second in command, next to the clan head Fuuma Danjo, for a long time. She has an evil eye in her left eye and has the powerful ability to take over the vision and consciousness of anyone whose eyes meet hers.

In the past, she was loyal to the late Danjo and was very active as a Taimanin. During some conflicts, both Saika and Mizuki Shiranui have fought against each other, both being of a similar age and developed some shared respect. Saika was highly skilled but one day, while on a mission, lost during a battle with a Demon Tribe, both of her legs were taken from her. Afterwards, she was rescued by Danjo and together they escaped to the UFS. She underwent operation, gaining two new mechanical prosthetic legs from "G".

Returning to Fuuma Village and the Fuuma Estate once more. She lived together with the very young Fuuma Kotaro and Fuuma Tokiko around these times. Since those events, Saika was even more loyal to Danjo and the clan but depending on timeline joined or rejected Danjo's Fuuma Revolt.

Timeline TABA
Fuuma Saika 6
She joined Fuuma Danjo in the Fuuma Revolt 2068, and became a traitor to the Gosha Taimanin, after Danjo tried to take over the village. Fleeing with him after this defeat, she still worked as his second in command secretary, together with Fuuma Amane. This version of Saika, viewed Fuuma Kotaro as a traitor for going against his father and building the Fuuma Organization, year 2082, she deemed the only worthy clan leader to be Danjo.

After Fuuma Tokiko was captured by Danjo's child Fuuma Ginrei, in year 2083, Saika was ordered to guard her location and defeat Fuuma Kotaro (TABA). Disguised as Tokiko, she tried to make a sneak attack on Kotaro but was knocked out, as Kotaro killed Fuuma Gisuke another Fuuma member and escaped with Tokiko.

Saika again appeared again in the year 2084, as part of a trap of Danjo. Using her Ninja Art, she tricked Yomi Akitsu and Gran to fight Fuuma Kotaro (TABA) and Fuuma Tokiko to escalate a fight for information so that both parties would kill each other. However, as she was discovered Saika was knocked down and this time captured.

After her capture by Kotaro, she was not saved by Danjo but escaped herself but was to late as Danjo had already been killed by Kotaro. She swore revenge and attacked both Tokiko and Kotaro. However, showed that she was mostly just devastated after her master's death and seeing herself in Tokiko. She was knocked out by Tokiko and traded as a captive on the spot to the Taimanin, to secure an escape and give Saika a chance to recover. Giving little information to Gosha Village, she remained imprisoned, for a while Saika almost had given up on life itself.

However, in the year 2086, her deep grudge was felt by the demon Chaos Order, which out on a whim, freed her. Saika refused at first to escape as she had given up. Chaos Order disappeared and told her to do what she wanted but the late arriving wood Taimanins Manami and Nao missunderstood the situation and started to attacking Saika, thinking she wanted to escape, which sparked a desire in Saika to flee afterall.

Now escaped from Gosha, both Fuuma Organization and Taimanin worked together to recapture her. Using that chance to strengthen herself and to get ready for Kotaro one more time. She implanted herself with genes of Fuuma Danjo by fertilizing one of her eggs. This lead to an Inner Demon-like transformation, now having some Danjo's power amd even more control over her Evil Eye. Guarded by KINGS-10 April and KINGS-11 Saix, she remained in one of the Fuuma hideouts, waiting for Kotaro.

When Kotaro arrived with Fuuma Tokiko and Yanagi Mutsuho, she fought the group with her powerful illusions, but in the end was defeated. Saika surprisingly accepted finally her defeat and joined the Fuuma Organization in honest. As only "what if "scenarios continue this plot line, she is either return to her normal form or remained in her inner demon form. In either case, Saika stayed loyal to Fuuma from that point on.

Saika afterwards joined Kotaro and did not break out ever again. As "What IF" scenes show multiple outcomes, she could have returned to her normal human-form in "sealed secretary" or remained in her Inner Demon in "Evil Eye Unleashed". In her last event, she appears at the final battle against Edwin Black, fighting together with Tekkain Kaworu and is able to switch between her normal and demon form. Just as Kaworu, she has decided to help Kotaro.

Timeline RPGX
RPGX Story Artwork 2
She was grateful to Danjo but would not support Danjo's planned a coup, year 2068, against Gosha village, and sided with Asagi instead, avoiding the conflict. From then on, she concentrated only on Taimanin missions, serving the Fuuma family after Danjo's death. As the secretary, she acted as the highest member of the clan for some time. However, she retired from her position as a Fuuma clan secretary, tossing the mantle to Fuuma Tokiko, which served the new clan master, Kotaro. Saika had returned to take care of household duties, mostly the many books and scrolls, left behind by Danjo and was semi-retired. However, with the start of RPGX, becomes more active.

In the year 2082, Saika is not seen during the Nisha Ninja Troops minor revolt and, it is stated she flat out refused to join the Fuuma Danjo Loyalists of Nisha Gaiza, as she had not fully agreed with Fuuma Danjo's revolt.

In the year 2083, leaked information of the Nisha Ninja Troops, allowed Task Force G to sent Major to Saika. During Valentines day, Saika was at the time in a minor contest with Kotaro and Fuuma Tokiko, to allow Kotaro to get valentines chocolate as he had received none and Tokiko would not allow any free one without effort. However, in that game, Kotaro found Saika as she was threatend by Major. Thanks to the assistance of Tokiko, as well that had kept an eye on Kotaro, Major could be captured.

Year 2085, she assisted in the arrest of the dangerous Mine Funako, together with Fuuma Amane, both were able to capture Funako alive.

In the year 2086, Saika is given Cloaking tech for a later mission and send out to support the lewd demon faction of Ambrose and Ishtar, against Ereshkigal Hades Incubus/Succubus troops. She then saved Repita Richster, a supplier of Orichalcum, from getting brainwashed by Erchikigal's troops and Wight. Both Ambrose and Ishtar approve of Saika's action and agree to the deal with Gosha. Thanks to the deal Saika is allowed to talk to the leader Ambrose and Ishtar, the missing Taimanin known as the Phantom Witch. Learning that her true identity is Mizuki Shiranui, her former foe and friend, Saika talks with Shiranui about her goals and view that this is another path to "justice" even if she requires to cut all ties to her old self and will be in blood. Returning, to headquarters and informing Asagi, both sides are now in a shaky alliance until Ereshkigal is defeated. The fact that Mizuki Yukikaze's mother had become a full demon that abandoned her humanity and family ties, is currently kept a secret by Asagi.

Timeline Action
Fuuma Saika 5
Follows RPGX timeline in which she opposed Danjo's planned coup. Overlooks the books and scrolls left behind by Fuuma Danjo and is a semi-retired but still active Taimanin, which has become more active recently again. She is somewhat unsure on her place in the current clan of Fuuma Kotaro, which she still supports at the moment. Saika also still denies to join any Danjo loyalist groups, which reject the village. she confesses her love to Kotaro during her Playable Intimacy scene, with Kotaro flustered and unsure how to respond.

Additionally she takes care of Granie of the DSO, for the time she is in Gosha Village.

She is fought in a short mock battle on (Not) Demon Island, when the entire Fuuma clan was taking a vacation. Saika later becomes more active and trains with Fuuma Tokiko, that both don't fall behind.


Powers/Abilities
Saika Ultimate
Main Weapon: Mechanical Legs

Ninja Art: "Evil Eye", "Takeover", her eye ability enables her to hijack an enemies eyesight. If an enemy looks in her eyes she is able to control his vision and force him to look where she wants. With that she can change what people perceive, like false copies or other people. If she blinks this breaks her control and she also is not able to move while using it. This makes it a powerful ability if she fights on the side of allies but makes it less effective if Saika fights alone.
Eternity: Stronger version, can be used while Saika is moving, which can be awoken, creates additionally missing memories when under her influence.
Mechanical Legs: Uses Prosthesis of Task Force G, a both medical and combat focused enhancement. As her Evil Art itself is not meant to deal damage and only creates opportunity, this is the main way Saika is able to fight. Saika also has non combat versions of these mechanical legs.
Martial Arts Expert: Fights with kicks, combined with her mechanical legs, gives her enough power alone to be a dangerious.
Particle Control: Taimanin are able to manipulate Taima Particles to enhance their physical strength, speed and defense. The particles also are used to counter demonic influences and strengthen damage to demons.
Demon Transformation: Able to transform at will, into a Inner Demon-like being, just as Igawa Asagi, and switch between normal and demon form. Increases the strength of her illusions and grants her abilities like flight. Only near the end of TABA, after implanting herself with cells of Danjo. The form has two wings a long tail, two horns, a third eye on the forehead. Her hair color is now purple. This form is not canon in AT or RPGX.

Trivia
The tag G Associates only apply to her TABA version.
Her Art is only ever called "Evil or Demon" Eye but not not given a clear name. Though, cards of her in TABA use the title "Takeover" twice, which could be the name.
The "job" of Stewardess or Steward for Taimanin means something closer to "House Guardian or clan guard". Secretary, maid and responsible for money, they are the highest ranked member next only to the clan head.
Saika is revealed in the same event that Mizuki Shiranui appears in TABA. Both also share some clothing choices and later friendship in RPGX. In RPGX, they encountered each other on the battlefield around the time of either the Fuuma Revolt or Igawa Revolt. Both are stated to be around the same age, which makes Saika around her mid-30s. However, no clear number is given.
Her height here is visually approximated from her model in Action Taimanin, compared to other models, with known character heights. Shares the same height with Sakura.
Etymology
Saika means "calamity, catastrophe, accident, mistake" (災禍).
